newsitem.title: USA: Boston Life Sciences developing eye drug.
newsitem.headline: Boston Life Sciences developing eye drug.

text.p: Boston Life Sciences Inc said on Friday that it is developing its Troponin I in eye drops to treat damaged corneas.

"We believe that the potential market for an effective anti-angiogenic compound to treat corneal and diabetic retinal diseases is substantial, and we are therefore very excited about the prospect of developing Troponin for these indications in addition to cancer," the company said.
The company has started preclinical development after Troponin I apparently caused a regression of blood vessels in the eyes of rats, Boston Life Sciences said.
In the experiment model, the corneas of rats were damaged to simulate an ulcer or injury and the animals were treated with Troponin I drops, the company said.
